_about: Public-domain Robert Vaughan (1795-1868), Congregational historian, President of Lancashire Independent College and founder of the British Quarterly Review, for the Word Hoard: The Life and Opinions of John de Wycliffe (1828, two volumes), The Causes of the Corruption of Christianity (1834), Thoughts on the Present Position of the Protestant Dissenters (1838), The Modern Pulpit (1842), Congregationalism (1842), Essays on History, Philosophy and Theology (1849) and John de Wycliffe, a Monograph (1853). C. J. Vaughan and Herbert Vaughan, on their own shelves, are other men. from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 59 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
